TUDOR DIMOFTE AND STAVROS GAROUFALIDIS

The Kashaev invariant of a knot $K$ is a sequence of complex numbers $\langle K \rangle_N$ indexed by a positive integer $N$ [@Kashaev95]. blocks.title: Ideal triangulations and Neumann-Zagier data
blocks.content:
[]{#sub.NZ label="sub.NZ"}

Ideal triangulations were introduced by Thurston as an efficient way to describe (algebraically, or numerically) 3-dimensional hyperbolic manifolds. For a leisure introduction, the reader may consult Thurston's original notes [@Th], the exposition of Neumann--Zagier [@NZ] and Weeks [@Weeks] and the documentation of `SnapPy` [@snappy]. The shape of a 3-dimensional hyperbolic tetrahedra is a complex number $z \in\mathbb C\setminus\{0,1\}$. blocks.title: Basic structure
blocks.content:
Chern-Simons theory with complex gauge group $G_\mathbb{C}$ (where $G$ is a compact Lie group) was initially studied by Witten in [@Witten-CSgrav; @Witten-cx]. It is a topological quantum field theory in three-dimensions, whose action is a sum of holomorphic and antiholomorphic copies of the usual Chern-Simons action

$$S(\mathcal A, \overline\mathcal A) = \frac{t}{8\pi} \,
I_{CS}(\mathcal A) + \frac{\tilde t}{8\pi}\, I_{CS}(\overline\mathcal A)\,,$$

where $\mathcal A$ is a connection on a $G_\mathbb{C}$ bundle over a 3-manifold $M$, and $I_{CS}(\mathcal A) = \int_M (\mathcal Ad\mathcal A+\fr

blocks.title: A singular limit
State integrals
blocks.content:
Complex Chern-Simons theory has not yet been made mathematically rigorous as a full TQFT, in contrast to Chern-Simons theory with a compact gauge group [@Witten-jones] and the Reshetikhin-Turaev construction [@RT]. Nevertheless, there exist state-integral models, based on ideal triangulations, that provide a definition of complex Chern-Simons partition functions for a certain class of 3-manifolds [@D-levelk; @AK]. These state-integral models generalize earlier work [@Hikami; @DGLZ; @Dimofte-QRS; @AK-TQFT; @AK-new] that computed Chern-Simons partition functions at level $k=1$.
